title: A LIFETIME LOSS READS WITH THE MINUS FIRST
why: Seen on the 4K YOUR STATS screenshot of 2026-10-08: net lifetime earnings below zero read $-9,750. It reads -$9,750 now.
now: A lifetime loss on the Mainframe reads -$9,750.

edits.replacement: h+=card('Net lifetime earnings', ((P.netEarn||0)<0?'-$':'$')+Math.abs(P.netEarn||0).toLocaleString(),   // v16.xx: a loss reads -$9,750, not $-9,750
